scope: isolated regularized central candidates before experimental replicas

fit_quality.interpretation: The smoothing prior may select within a shallow likelihood valley but may not buy smoothness with a material degradation of the data objective.

hyperparameter_robustness.interpretation: A result that is unique only at one finely tuned lambda is not robust.

finite_b_transform_robustness.active_definition: absolute expb2 median >5% of each flavor peak for kT<=2.25 GeV

ensemble_completion.experimental_replica_count: determine adaptively until 16th and 84th percentile curves are stable; do not assume the legacy count is sufficient

selection_rule: Select the weakest regularization strength satisfying every gate. Fig. 6 band width is optimized only among gate-passing dataset/model choices.
